title: Create: Age of Vehicles | Modrinth
description: Adds the ability to create vehicles with Create Mod
body:
======================================================================

Ever thought, "Hmmm... I wanna make a car" while playing minecraft? Well with this modpack, you can do exactly that. This modpack gives you the ability to not only build a working car, but control it with a controller!

This pack includes:

- Create | Adds technology and a more mechanical side to Minecraft
  
- Drive-By-Wire | An addon to Trackwork that allows for wires instead of redstone when developing vehicles
  
- Eureka! | Allows for the creation of physics entities
  
- Valkyrien Skies | Uses Eureka! to create airships and such
  
- Trackwork | Uses Create, Eureka!, and Valkyrien Skies to add the ability to make vehicles with working suspension and such
  
- Alex's Mobs | Adds tons of new wildlife to find around the world
  
- Essential | Adds more of a social system, allows you to join friends worlds without servers
  
- The Macaw family of mods | Adds bunch of new building blocks
  
- The MrCrayfish family of mods | Adds more new building blocks
  
- Particular | Adds little particle effects here and there to make your world feel livelier
  
- And more!

========================================================================

New menus are in progress, and quests are in progress for an enhanced survival experience
